findings.evidence: “To pin a skill, add its name as a keyword to the category you want” conflicts with step 2's requirement that a keyword equal “a hyphen-separated token of the skill name.” A complete hyphenated name cannot equal one of its individual tokens, so the documented pinning branch does not work. Multi-token keywords such as `c4-architecture` likewise cannot match during the name pass.
findings.fix: In step 2, check each category's keywords against both the complete skill name and its individual hyphen-separated tokens, retaining the existing category precedence and name-before-description ordering. This makes full-name pins effective when placed before any competing match.

findings.evidence: “Save a copy of README.md (`cp README.md "$(mktemp)"`)” does not retain or display the temporary filename, but the next step requires agents to “diff the saved copy” and restore it on a mismatch. Following the supplied command leaves no recorded backup path for those operations.
findings.fix: Capture and display the backup path, for example `backup=$(mktemp) && cp README.md "$backup" && printf '%s\n' "$backup"`, and stop before editing if backup creation or copying fails. Use the recorded path for both the verification diff and restoration.
